questions.stem_text: PreP is an effective strategy for reducing the incidence of HIV in:
Laryngeal oedema is usually confined to the larynx above the vocal folds because

options.A: there are numerous mucous glands in the vestibular folds.
options.B: the mucosa covering the vocal folds is tightly attached to underlying tissues.
options.C: fluid will drain rapidly into the thorax below the vocal folds.
